fields.Name: IT166 - Predictive Shadow Scoring and Drift
fields.Description: Exercises Predictive Studio shadow scoring and PSI drift evaluation end-to-end (deterministic, no sidecar). PSD1: creates a test Record Process with ChallengerConfigurationObject, runs champion + challenger scoring, and verifies Role='Champion' (non-null ValueKeyHash) and Role='Challenger' (ValueKeyHash=null) rows in MJ: Feature Values while FeatureValueCacheService returns only the Champion value. PSD2: seeds baseline and drifted evaluation MJ: Feature Values rows and invokes PredictiveStudioEvaluateDriftAction through ActionEngineServer, verifying both MinSampleSize=100 InsufficientData gating and MinSampleSize=10 OverallSeverity='Critical' alert emission.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Shadow challenger rows persist with Role='Challenger' and ValueKeyHash=null without polluting champion cache reads; PredictiveStudioEvaluateDriftAction loads windows from MJ: Feature Values, enforces MinSampleSize=100 InsufficientData gating, detects Critical PSI drift at MinSampleSize=10, and emits an alert record.
